claims.claim: Surrey council will be asked to vote yes to all of newly elected mayor Doug McCallum's campaign promises at its inaugural meeting on Monday.
claims.episode_span: Surrey council is being asked to vote yes to all of newly elected mayor Doug McCallum's campaign promises at its inaugural meeting on Monday.
claims.source_title: Surrey Mayor Doug McCallum calls for immediate action on all campaign promises
claims.supporting_quote: Surrey council will be asked to vote yes to all of newly-elected mayor Doug McCallum’s campaign promises at its inaugural meeting on Monday.

claims.claim: Doug McCallum was re-elected with 31.8 per cent of the vote and his Safe Surrey Coalition won all but one seat on the nine-member council.
claims.episode_span: was re-elected with 31.8 per cent of the vote. He and the Safe Surrey Coalition won all but one seat on the nine-member council
claims.source_title: Surrey Mayor Doug McCallum calls for immediate action on all campaign promises
claims.supporting_quote: He was mayor from 1996 to 2005, from 2018 to 2022, and was re-elected with 31.8 per cent of the vote in 2026.

claims.claim: As of 5 p.m. PCT Sunday, B.C. Hydro customers without power had dropped from roughly 135,000 overnight Saturday to about 30,000, with more than 8,000 in the Central Interior.
claims.episode_span: customers without power had fallen from roughly 135,000 overnight Saturday to about 30,000
claims.source_title: B.C. Hydro power outages could stretch into Tuesday as crews continue to repair storm damage
claims.supporting_quote: As of 5 p.m. PCT Sunday, the number of customers without power had dropped from roughly 135,000 overnight Saturday to about 30,000, according to the utility. More than 8,000 of those were in the Central Interior.

claims.claim: Seaspan Careen returned to Vancouver harbour this week after upgrades in Indonesia and will be back on the North Vancouver waterfront in February.
claims.episode_span: Seaspan Careen is back in Vancouver harbour this week after upgrades in Indonesia.
claims.source_title: Massive Seaspan drydock returns from overseas upgrades
claims.supporting_quote: Seaspan Careen will be back in its usual spot on the North Vancouver waterfront in February. The drydock returned to the harbour this week after undergoing upgrades in Indonesia

claims.claim: Calls to reopen B.C.'s grizzly bear hunt are growing after a fatal attack on a mother and daughter in Bella Coola, and there were about 15,000 grizzly bears in B.C. in 2018.
claims.episode_span: calls to reopen B.C.'s grizzly bear hunt are growing louder. There were about 15,000 grizzly bears across B.C. in 2018
claims.source_title: Fatal grizzly attack triggers debate about B.C. hunting ban
claims.supporting_quote: As daily life resumes in the shadow of a deadly grizzly bear attack on a mother and daughter in Bella Coola, calls to reopen B.C.'s grizzly bear hunt are growing louder.

claims.claim: Okanagan Falls swore in its first mayor, Matt Taylor, and councillors Amy Bydal, Eugene Dettling, Randy Ludwar and Allison Symons on Friday.
claims.episode_span: Mayor Matt Taylor took the oath with councillors Amy Bydal, Eugene Dettling, Randy Ludwar and Allison Symons.
claims.source_title: Okanagan Falls swears in its first ever mayor and council
claims.supporting_quote: Mayor Matt Taylor took the oath of office alongside councillors Amy Bydal, Eugene Dettling, Randy Ludwar, and Allison Symons.

claims.claim: Pte. Aidan Goulding, 23, was remembered at a Vancouver funeral after being killed with three other soldiers in a grass fire at CFB Wainwright; 39 other soldiers were taken to hospital.
claims.episode_span: The fire killed Goulding, Sergeant Morgan Wong, Private Shaun Farrell and Private Hayden Lykkemark. Another 39 soldiers were taken to hospital at the time.
claims.source_title: Mom says B.C. soldier who died at CFB Wainwright was her ‘bright light’
claims.supporting_quote: A grassfire overtook soldiers during the exercise, killing Goulding as well as Sgt. Morgan Wong, Pte. Shaun Farrell and Pte. Hayden Lykkemark. Another 39 soldiers were taken to hospital at the time.

claims.claim: Tonight's Canucks-Flyers game streams only on Sportsnet+, with puck drop at 7:30 p.m. PCT, and it is the first of nine exclusive Sportsnet+ Canucks games.
claims.episode_span: It streams only on Sportsnet+ as Monday Night Hockey, with puck drop at 7:30 p.m. PCT at Rogers Arena.
claims.source_title: How to watch tonight's streaming-only Vancouver Canucks game
claims.supporting_quote: This will be the first of nine Canucks games this season that will be streamed exclusively on Sportsnet+.

claims.claim: The Montreal Roses beat the Vancouver Rise 5-2 over a two-game Northern Super League semifinal series and advanced to the final.
claims.episode_span: The Montreal Roses are through to the Northern Super League final after beating the Vancouver Rise 5-2 over a two-game semifinal series.
claims.source_title: Vancouver Rise bow out after loss to Montreal Roses in NSL semifinal series
claims.supporting_quote: The Montreal Roses are off to the Northern Super League final after downing the Vancouver Rise 5-2 over a two-game semifinal series.

claims.claim: Environment Canada has a special weather statement for Vancouver and Sea to Sky, with rain beginning Monday afternoon, a high of 12, and 10 to 15 mm Monday night.
